remarks: Classic Colonial with Stunning Views in a Prime Location Nestled on a coveted cul-de-sac, this classic four-bedroom Colonial offers sweeping views of the Forever Green Land Trust and the serene Five Mile River. Set on one acre of beautiful park like property, the home features Connecticut stone walls and a level front and back yard, elevated for optimal vistas. This spacious home is connected to public water and sewer, offering both comfort and convenience. Enjoy the outdoors from the charming screened porch or the patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A new roof adds to the home's appeal, ensuring years of worry-free living. Ideally located close to town, this property provides the perfect balance of privacy and accessibility. Bring your vision and make this incredible home your own!
